scenes.summary: You see a troubled Yan Ning at the entrance of the Tianshi Bureau Academy. She seems to be thinking about ways of handling the recent Blight disasters.

lines.text: Hmm... This can be improved upon... Oh? Endmin? We meet again. There's something I want to discuss with you.
Data from our monitoring center revealed an upward trend for region-wide Depth readings of Wuling. The Blight is becoming increasingly active.
I plan to develop a ⟦key|Xiranite-based protection device⟧ that can safeguard the health of our residents against ambient Blight in the environment.
I believe the Qingbo Stockaders need the Xiranite-based protection device more than we do.
If we do things the old way, like placing large stockpiles at the Field Logistics Depot... we can't really upgrade the devices quickly enough. Plus, the Stockaders might get suspicious.
Dealing with the Blight outside the city has taken a serious toll on Fangyi...
I'm just so glad you're willing to help... By the way, Endmin, this here is Zuo Guyan, a watchguard who volunteered to assist stock redistribution.
Greetings. Just call me Guyan, Endmin. I'll do my best but please forgive my shortcomings, if any.
Oh? Hmm... Strange. But my guide told me that this is the proper way to greet a superior...
Yeah. Got a book titled "Did You Get Promoted Today?" Chapter One — Be Proactive in Sharing Your Superior's Woes.
Endmin, maybe we can help Tianshi Yan Ning upgrade her Xiranite-based protection device?
If we succeed, Tianshi Yan Ning and Viceroy Zhuang would be spared quite a bit of work, right?
There are still a few Xiranite-based protection device upgrades I need to work on... I'll come looking for you once it is ready.
Wonderful!
My promo... Ahem. Of course, we're doing all this to share Tianshi Yan Ning's burdens. I shall heed your command, Endmin.

options: Okay. So what problem did you run into?
I can help deliver the devices to Qingbo Stockade.
No problem. Leave that to me.
You sound a lot more eager than I am...
So I'll go and talk to Yan Ning first?

scenes.summary: You help Yan Ning upgrade the Xiranite-based protection device. She names it the "Xiranite Gourd" and promises to carry out all device upgrades in the future. Yan Ning also asks if you can help produce the Xiranite Gourds for the people who need them.

lines.text: Oh? Yeah. I'm still thinking about the upgrades. The design drawings are still a little rough.
But witnessing the Endmin coming up with device upgrades is a good learning experience. Come here, Bai Shuang. Pay close attention!
Yes, ma'am!
It simply swapped the original construction for more basic materials...
The protection device is based on the Experimental Xiranite Bottle, which is essentially an Originium-based product. Did the Protorig achieve this...?
We know too little about the Protorig. Hmm. This approach actually offers a rather substantial optimization.
Bai Shuang and I shall handle subsequent iterations of the protection device... I'll call it the "⟦key|Xiranite Gourd⟧" for now.
I'll leave the production and distribution of the ⟦key|Xiranite Gourds⟧ to you, Endmin.
Endmin? Is there anything I can help you with?

options: Need help upgrading the protection device?
Can I look at the protection device blueprints?

r: Need help upgrading the protection device?
Can I look at the protection device blueprints?

scenes.summary: You arrive at Qingbo Stockade. However, Liao the Scarless is suspicious of the Xiranite Gourds you brought. You use your skills and successfully convince Liao and the other Stockaders to try out the Xiranite Gourds.

lines.text: Oh, Darkmask! I know you. Were you the one who delivered the gourds to the Stockade?
Back to the Stockade, huh. What's your biz?
Xiranite...? The artsy green dirt from Wuling? See, connections are awesome. We got ourselves a load of Wuling loot.
Say, some of the Fam working out in the wilderness got hurt. Can this little thing ... really work?
Darkmask, the Fam has faith in you, but this gourd ... doesn't really look useful.
Methinks the gourd is more like a ... small trinket.
We do trust you, Darkmask. But we gotta test out the gourds. If they work, the Fam will take them off your hands.
And if they don't... I don't think it's a big deal. We'll just keep wearing it like a charm.
I don't think the Wulingers are trying to manipulate us with these gadgets.

options: The gourds are Xiranite-based protection devices.
The Xiranite Gourds can help deal with Blight hazards.
The Tianshi made this for the Wulingers hurt by the Blight.
It got me covered to get back to the Stockade.
The Xiranite within the gourd offers the protection.
It works like the Tianshi Pillar defending Wuling, actually.
Unless you stick your feet in the Blight, it's good enough.
